teamNews.text: Hull City · Matt Crooks returns from suspension. Belloumi, Mendy and Hughes face fitness checks.
Brighton & Hove Albion · Minteh and Azeez face fitness tests. Struijk, Andrés and Hadjam could return.
Liverpool · Van Dijk and Szoboszlai are available. Bradley, Leoni and Ekitike remain out.
Manchester United · Lisandro Martínez returns from suspension. Dorgu and Maguire have trained.
Barcelona · Bardghji, Espart and Rodri are out. Koundé, Cubarsí and Olmo need late checks.
Villarreal · Diatta is out. Foyth, Gerard Moreno and Akhomach are major doubts.
Racing Santander · Álvaro Mantilla and Andrés Martín face late checks. Zabiri is expected to lead the line.
Real Sociedad · Odriozola is out. Barrenetxea is a major doubt, and Oyarzabal has returned to action with Spain.
Osasuna · Aimar Oroz, Herrando and Del Castillo need late checks. Budimir is expected to lead the line.
Málaga · Adam Aznou is suspended. Juan Cruz and Julen Lobete are among the expected injury absences.
Getafe · Gudelj is suspended. Uche, Romero and Juanmi are injured.
Atlético Madrid · Grimaldo needs a fitness check. Pubill is doubtful, and Lookman and Romero are expected to miss out.
FC Cincinnati · Hagglund and Robinson are doubtful. Anunga and Hadebe are unavailable.
Chicago Fire FC · Noah Allen and Robin Lod are doubtful. Lewandowski has scored three in his last two matches.
Charlotte FC · Ream, Goodwin and John are doubtful. Berchimas is recovering from foot surgery.
Vancouver Whitecaps · Adekugbe, Badwal, Cubas and Sabbi are doubtful. Cabrera and Halbouni are out.
Real Salt Lake · Arias, Booth, Eneli, Luna and Piol are out.
FC Augsburg · Massengo and Matsima are out. Gregoritsch is expected to start up front.
Mainz · Dominik Kohr is out with an ankle injury.
Werder Bremen · Topp, Musah, Stage and Alvero are unavailable. Grüll and Weiser face fitness checks.
Hamburg SV · Torunarigha, Lokonga, Nadir and Remberg are out. Vušković could return.
Juventus · Çelik, Cambiaso and Conceição are back in contention. Yıldız, Thuram and Locatelli remain out.
Venezia · Akor Adams is expected up front, with Yeboah and Lauerbach competing to partner him.
Bologna · Enem, Miranda and Holm are out. Cambiaghi has resumed training.
Udinese · Bertola and Gueye are out. Alaba could return, and Zaniolo is available.
Sassuolo · Berardi, Volpato and Boloca are among several players facing fitness tests.
Genoa · Frendrup is doubtful after missing the previous match with an ankle problem.
AC Milan · Maignan is back in training. Pavlović is a doubt, and Tomori and Gabbia remain out.
Frosinone · Top scorer Antonio Raimondo picked up an injury.
Atalanta · Hien, Kossounou and Kristensen are out. Bellanova and Raspadori are available again.
Internazionale · Lautaro Martínez is in contention after injury. Aleksandar Stanković and Ange-Yoan Bonny are sidelined.
Paris FC · Ikoné and Sangui are out. Camara and Chergui are doubtful.
Angers · Lefort is suspended. Diatta and Pona are unavailable, and El Ouazzani returns.
Lorient · Touré and Katseris are unavailable. Fadiga is back in training.
Stade Rennais · Lepaul is available after an ankle issue. Frankowski is doubtful.
Marseille · Emerson and Cornelius remain out. Gouiri has scored in three consecutive league games.
Le Mans · Bourabaa and Sidibé are out. Yohou and Rossignol are uncertain.
FC Twente · Unnerstall, Bruns and Lemkin are out. Weghorst is projected to start up front.
Willem II · Hoogma and Lachkar are out. Didillon is a doubt.
Ajax Amsterdam · Brandt and Gaaei face checks. Adingra, Dolberg and Tsygankov are out.
ADO Den Haag · Pozo and Reischl are out.
Sparta Rotterdam · Brouwer is a doubt in goal. Bednarek is in line to deputize.
AZ Alkmaar · Hornkamp, Resink and Zoet are out. Schouten is doubtful.
Go Ahead Eagles · Saathof, Waayers and Marsman remain out. Cillessen is expected in goal.
Fortuna Sittard · Guth, Michut, Zeefuik, Sinkgraven and Romeny missed the previous game. Bayram remains out.
Goztepe · Sabra, Furkan and Gugeshashvili are reported injured.
Konyaspor · Demirbağ is out and Awaziem is unlikely to feature. Jevtović and Yazğılı need fitness checks.
Trabzonspor · Nwaiwu is suspended. Batagov, Dju, Malinovskyi and Yokuşlu are expected to miss out.
